proposed_published_schema.proposal: Publish the raw 2023 shapefile verbatim (all 18 attribute fields plus geometry) in a single shapefile-typed format object; no column mapping, no substitute row IDs, no schema widening.
proposed_published_schema.id_contract: GEOID preserved as zero-padded 5-character string (state FIPS + county FIPS); GEOIDFQ and COUNTYNS retained; no generated IDs

refresh_cadence: annual, tied to the Census TIGER/Line late-year postings of COUNTY under a new TIGER{year} directory
idempotency: content-derived version from pinned zip sha256 plus processing identity; re-running with the same bytes reuses the sealed candidate
completeness_gate: pinned byte-level sha256/length of the exact zip, full archive extraction, 3235 unique GEOIDs, no null/empty/invalid geometry
error_handling: any capture or validation failure quarantines the full raw capture under _quarantine/us-county-boundaries-1/ and blocks promotion
drift_quarantine: pinned sha256, member roster, schema, field roster, CLASSFP/FUNCSTAT value sets, ID digest, and coverage bounds checks all quarantine instead of adapting
